title: fullsend lint JSON report
description: Stdout document written by `fullsend lint --format json`. schema_version 2 adds a required diagnostic code. schema_version 1 was the shape from https://github.com/fullsend-ai/fullsend/pull/8995 and https://github.com/fullsend-ai/fullsend/pull/9066.

schema_version.description: Document version. 2 is the current schema.

success.description: true when the process would exit 0.

errors.description: Count of error-severity items in diagnostics.

warnings.description: Count of warning-severity items in diagnostics.

diagnostics.description: One object per finding. Never null; no findings is [].

code.description: Stable identifier for the lint rule or failure class. Independent of message wording. Not an enum; new codes may appear without a schema_version bump.

agent.description: Agent name, or "config" for config-level findings.

field.description: Harness field path. Empty when a harness fails to resolve, load, or validate.
